column1: # Challenge Keyword Finder - situational conditions -> plain 'Also needs' lines (hand-made, edit freely).
# These conditions don't name a thing (a creature, an item); they say WHEN or WHERE it counts.
# function = the condition function. match = regex on the condition's parameter (blank = any).
# op = == != > >= < <= or any. value = the compared number (blank = any).
# text = what the page shows. guide = guide_index.tsv id or /url/ to link the line (optional) -
#   only linked if that guide row is visibility=public and status=published.
# The first matching row wins. A condition with no row stays off the page (listed in the audit).
